baseline_bump_justification: 2026-06-13 EN/FR i18n sweep COMPLETE for all customer-facing surfaces. The local/no-untranslated-literal rule was promoted to ERROR for src/components, src/pages and 21 cleaned feature dirs (see the i18n-clean override block in apps/web/eslint.config.js); those dirs now carry ZERO untranslated user-facing literals and cannot regress. The internal super-admin panel (src/features/admin, ~335 literals) is DEFERRED and stays WARN-ratcheted. Net effect vs the prior i18n bump: web 12375 -> 11739 (-636) and pos 101 -> 40 (-61) as ~270 literals were translated to EN+FR and the rule stopped counting test files. PRIOR bumps: 2026-06-12 introduced the rule at WARN (web 11662->12375, pos 40->101); 2026-05-30 Phase-11 precision-guard (web 11343->11662).
